chapter: Sidemen, the Hampton years, race and money
title: Booker Ervin and John Handy on tenor
summary: Ervin's time in the band; Handy's Body and Soul at the Five Spot.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And I guess the name that I think of most frequently as associated with you is Danny. How about Booker? Ervin? Irwin? called his name already.
Yeah, you did. How long did he play with you?
John Handy -- I don't know how long.
At least a year, off and on, when I was working. John Handy, I liked John Handy on tenor. Most people don't know him as a tenor player, but he played tenor.
I don't think I've heard of him as a
tenor player. Did he record on tenor with you?

No, he recorded but -- at the Five Spot one time when Sonny Rollins had a band there. John played On "Body and Soul," tenor. I never heard anything any better. I never knew anyone " " could play Body and Soul any better.
